title: TSS Record Schema
description: An append-only auditable entry describing a stewardship event. Defined by TSS v1.1.1 §5.9 and §9. Domain-specific record types (StewardshipRecord, WellnessRecord, TENURE Record) MUST satisfy these rules. v1.2: added optional decision-confidence fields (decision_confidence, expected_outcome, actual_outcome, outcome_assessed_at) for decision records.

decision_confidence.description: Optional. Estimated probability of desired outcome at decision time, expressed as 0–1. Records epistemic state at the moment of decision, not hindsight. Applies when event_type represents a decision record. See QSM §4.2 and Memory layer contract in QSM-ARCH v1.1.0 §5.4.

expected_outcome.description: Optional. The outcome this decision was intended to produce, stated at decision time before the outcome is known.

actual_outcome.description: Optional. The outcome that actually occurred. Populated by the Observation or Adaptation layer after the fact, not at decision time.

outcome_assessed_at.description: Optional. Timestamp of when actual_outcome was recorded. MUST be after timestamp.
